summary: Fixed the ledger package against docs/conventions.md; all 755 tests pass. Fixes: half-away-from-zero rounding, minus sign in formatting, 6-month rate lookback that never looks forward, reversals booked and valued on the original's date, per-entry rounding in totals, tax rule effective dates, fiscal quarter start, header-over-dialect layout, rate file reading, HTML total sign, and own rounding calls. tools/audit.py still reports 1 failed check (6.2). Its case expects no rate 4 months back, which contradicts the 6-month MAX_LOOKBACK in the conventions note, so I followed the note.
